name: Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group Co., Ltd. specializes in the wind energy sector, designing and manufacturing wind turbines. The company also oversees the operation and maintenance of wind farms situated across China. Boasting a considerable footprint, its collective installed wind power capacity now exceeds 11 gigawatts. Established in 2006 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, the firm operates as an affiliate of Shanghai Electric Group Company Limited.
